description.narrative: The China Second Shandong Environment Project's objective is to improve the environmental conditions in participating municipalities and counties through a package of priority interventions including upgrading and development o f waste water collection and treatment facilities, river embankment rehabilitation, solid waste management, water supply improvements, industrial pollution monitoring, and enhancement o f the financial performance and efficiency o f key urban environmental service agencies. The project has the following four components: (a) wastewater collection network and treatment facilities in Gaomi, Huantai, Qixia, Weifang, Weihai, Yantai and Zaozhuang, with associated river embankment rehabilitation in Qixia, Weifang and Zaozhuang, and development of a pilot septic tank management system in Yantai co-financed by GEF; (b) solid waste management in Heze and Rizhao; (c) water supply improvements in Gaomi and Huantai; and (d) institutional development and capacity building for utilities, Environmental Protection Bureaus (EPBs) and decision makers.

The development objective is to improve the environmental conditions in participating municipalities/counties through a package of priority interventions, including upgrading and development of wastewater collection and treatment facilities, river embankment rehabilitation, solid waste management, water supply improvements, industrial pollution monitoring, and enhancement of the financial performance and efficiency of key urban environmental service agencies.
